title: Seedream 5.0 Pro Guide: Features, Price and Prompts
summary: Seedream 5.0 Pro guide: what ByteDance's image model does, what it costs in Flick, and six real test prompts with results, from posters to storyboards.
body_markdown:
### What is Seedream 5.0 Pro?


Seedream 5.0 Pro is ByteDance Seed's flagship image model, launched on July 8, 2026, for layouts, dense designs and text in many languages. In Flick it makes and edits images at 1.5K or 2K from a prompt and up to 10 reference images.


### How much does Seedream 5.0 Pro cost?


In Flick, Seedream 5.0 Pro costs 14 credits an image at 1.5K and 28 at 2K. Edits cost the same, and reference images add nothing.


### Is Seedream 5.0 Pro free?


Seedream 5.0 Pro runs on Flick's Free plan, and each image uses credits. A new Flick account gets 100 credits, enough for several Seedream 5.0 Pro images.


### Can Seedream 5.0 Pro write text in images?


Yes. In our tests it spelled a poster title, a tagline, three comic balloons and four storyboard labels correctly, and wrote a Japanese café sign right. It dropped the accent from "Café", so check accented letters.


### What languages does Seedream 5.0 Pro support?


ByteDance says Seedream 5.0 Pro takes prompts and renders text natively in over ten widely used languages. We tested Japanese and English in one image, and both came back readable.


### What is the difference between Seedream 5.0 Pro and Seedream 5.0 Lite?


In Flick, Seedream 5.0 Lite costs 7 credits an image and Seedream 5.0 Pro 14. ByteDance positions Pro for dense layouts, multilingual text and precise editing.


### Can I use Flickpedia styles with Seedream 5.0 Pro?


Yes. Seedream 5.0 Pro accepts Flickpedia styles in Flick, which send the style's reference images with your prompt. We have not tested a style on it yet, so this guide shows plain prompts.
